storage: Keep the head unwashed in a loose bag in the fridge; cut florets keep 2 to 3 days in a closed box.
looksLike: A dense white head (curd) made of tiny florets, wrapped in pale green leaves; mild, slightly nutty taste when cooked.
howToPick: A tight, creamy-white, heavy head with fresh green leaves. Avoid brown spots, loose or spreading florets, a yellow tinge or a sour smell.
shelfLife: About 5 to 7 days in the fridge (general guidance; not from a source in this run).
